title: Ngữ pháp – Cooling the Concrete City

grammar.key: S + be + V_pp (estimated/believed/thought/said) + to have + V_pp
grammar.name: Bị động khách quan nói về quá khứ (Impersonal passive + perfect infinitive)
grammar.formula:
S + am/is/are + V_pp (estimated/believed/thought/said/reported) + to have + V_pp
S + am/is/are + V_pp + to have been + V_pp  (bị động)
= It + is + V_pp + that + S + V_ed
grammar.meaningVi: Đưa ra ước tính, nhận định chung về một sự việc ĐÃ xảy ra mà không cần nói ai đưa ra — văn phong khách quan, rất hợp Writing Task 1, Task 2 và bài báo khoa học.
grammar.notes: Dùng "to have + V_pp" khi sự việc xảy ra TRƯỚC thời điểm nhận định; sự việc ở hiện tại/tương lai dùng "to + V". Nếu chủ ngữ chịu tác động: "to have been + V_pp".

examples.en: That attitude changed after the heatwave of 2003, which is estimated to have caused more than seventy thousand deaths across Europe.
examples.vi: Thái độ đó thay đổi sau đợt nắng nóng năm 2003, đợt nắng nóng được ước tính đã gây ra hơn bảy mươi nghìn ca tử vong khắp châu Âu.

examples.en: Deforestation is thought to have contributed to the decline of several bird species.
examples.vi: Nạn phá rừng được cho là đã góp phần làm suy giảm một số loài chim.

examples.en: The ancient city is believed to have been abandoned around 500 BC.
examples.vi: Thành phố cổ được cho là đã bị bỏ hoang vào khoảng năm 500 TCN.

exercises.prompt: The Industrial Revolution is thought ___ the first large-scale increase in carbon emissions.
answer: to have caused
exercises.explanation: Sự việc ở quá khứ, nhận định ở hiện tại → is thought + to have + V_pp.

exercises.prompt: The drought is believed ___ thousands of farmers to leave the region in the last decade.
answer: to have forced
exercises.explanation: "in the last decade" là quá khứ → to have forced.

exercises.prompt: Around 40 per cent of the forest is estimated ___ between 1990 and 2020.
answer: to have disappeared
exercises.explanation: Khoảng thời gian đã qua (1990–2020) → to have + V_pp.

exercises.prompt: The new congestion charge is reported ___ car use in the city centre by a quarter.
answer: to have reduced
exercises.explanation: Kết quả đã đạt được → to have reduced.

exercises.prompt: Many ancient manuscripts are said ___ in the fire of 1731.
answer: to have been destroyed
exercises.explanation: Bản thảo bị phá huỷ (bị động) trong quá khứ → to have been + V_pp.

exercises.prompt: The policy is believed to have help more than two million low-income families.
answer: The policy is believed to have helped more than two million low-income families.
exercises.explanation: Sau "to have" phải là V_pp: helped.

exercises.prompt: The earthquake is estimated to has damaged over ten thousand homes.
answer: The earthquake is estimated to have damaged over ten thousand homes.
exercises.explanation: Sau "to" luôn là dạng nguyên mẫu: to have (không "to has").

exercises.prompt: The species is thought to have became extinct in the late nineteenth century.
answer: The species is thought to have become extinct in the late nineteenth century.
exercises.explanation: V_pp của become là become, không phải became.

exercises.prompt: Air pollution is estimated to have cause around four million premature deaths in 2019.
answer: Air pollution is estimated to have caused around four million premature deaths in 2019.
exercises.explanation: to have + V_pp: caused.

exercises.prompt: The bridge is said to have built by Roman engineers almost two thousand years ago.
answer: The bridge is said to have been built by Roman engineers almost two thousand years ago.
exercises.explanation: Cây cầu được xây (bị động) → to have been built.

exercises.prompt: Experts estimate that the flood destroyed more than 500 homes.
exercises.instruction: Viết lại, bắt đầu bằng "The flood"
answer: The flood is estimated to have destroyed more than 500 homes.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ mệnh đề that lên đầu + is estimated + to have + V_pp.

exercises.prompt: People believe that the first universities appeared in North Africa and the Middle East.
exercises.instruction: Viết lại, bắt đầu bằng "The first universities"
answer: The first universities are believed to have appeared in North Africa and the Middle East.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều → are believed; sự việc quá khứ → to have appeared.

exercises.prompt: It is thought that the campaign changed public attitudes towards recycling.
exercises.instruction: Viết lại, bắt đầu bằng "The campaign"
answer: The campaign is thought to have changed public attitudes towards recycling.
exercises.explanation: It is thought that S + V_ed → S + is thought + to have + V_pp.

exercises.prompt: Researchers report that the programme improved literacy rates in rural areas.
exercises.instruction: Viết lại, bắt đầu bằng "The programme"
answer: The programme is reported to have improved literacy rates in rural areas.
exercises.explanation: report → is reported + to have improved.

exercises.prompt: It is said that the city was founded by traders in the twelfth century.
exercises.instruction: Viết lại, bắt đầu bằng "The city"
answer: The city is said to have been founded by traders in the twelfth century.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề gốc bị động ở quá khứ → to have been founded.

exercises.prompt: Trận cháy rừng được ước tính đã thiêu rụi hơn một triệu héc-ta.
answer: The wildfire is estimated to have burned more than one million hectares.
The forest fire is estimated to have burned more than one million hectares.
The wildfire is estimated to have destroyed more than one million hectares.
exercises.explanation: "được ước tính đã…" → is estimated to have + V_pp.

exercises.prompt: Chính sách này được cho là đã làm giảm tỉ lệ thất nghiệp ở người trẻ.
answer: This policy is believed to have reduced youth unemployment.
This policy is thought to have reduced youth unemployment.
This policy is believed to have reduced unemployment among young people.

hints.vi: tỉ lệ thất nghiệp ở người trẻ

exercises.explanation: "được cho là đã…" → is believed/thought to have + V_pp.

exercises.prompt: Nền văn minh cổ đại này được cho là đã sụp đổ vì hạn hán kéo dài.
answer: This ancient civilisation is thought to have collapsed because of a prolonged drought.
This ancient civilization is thought to have collapsed because of a prolonged drought.
This ancient civilisation is believed to have collapsed because of a prolonged drought.
This ancient civilization is believed to have collapsed because of a prolonged drought.
exercises.explanation: Sự kiện quá khứ → to have collapsed.

exercises.prompt: Hàng nghìn loài được cho là đã biến mất trong thế kỷ qua.
answer: Thousands of species are thought to have disappeared over the past century.
Thousands of species are believed to have disappeared over the past century.
Thousands of species are thought to have disappeared in the last century.
Thousands of species are believed to have disappeared in the last century.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều → are thought; quá khứ → to have disappeared.

exercises.prompt: Ngôi đền được cho là đã được xây dựng hơn một nghìn năm trước.
answer: The temple is said to have been built more than a thousand years ago.
The temple is believed to have been built more than a thousand years ago.
The temple is thought to have been built more than a thousand years ago.
The temple is said to have been built over a thousand years ago.
exercises.explanation: Đền "được xây" (bị động) trong quá khứ → to have been built.

exercises.prompt: The scheme is estimated ___ around 12,000 jobs since it began in 2015.
answer: to have created
exercises.explanation: Kết quả tính đến nay từ một mốc quá khứ → to have created; "to create" là hiện tại/tương lai; "to be created" là bị động.

exercises.prompt: Large parts of the coastline are believed ___ under water by 2100 if emissions keep rising.
answer: to be
exercises.explanation: Dự đoán cho tương lai (by 2100) → to + V, không dùng to have + V_pp.

exercises.prompt: The painting is thought ___ in the 1600s, but its artist remains unknown.
answer: to have been painted
exercises.explanation: Bức tranh "được vẽ" (bị động) trong quá khứ → to have been painted.

exercises.prompt: Over 60 per cent of adults are reported ___ social media every day nowadays.
answer: to use
exercises.explanation: Thói quen hiện tại (nowadays) → to + V.

exercises.prompt: The ship is said ___ while it was carrying gold to Spain.
answer: to have sunk
exercises.explanation: Sự việc đã xảy ra trong quá khứ → to have sunk (sink – sank – sunk).

grammar.name: Mệnh đề "which" thay cho cả câu phía trước (Sentential relative clause)
grammar.formula:
Clause, which + V  (which = toàn bộ sự việc ở mệnh đề trước)
Clause, which means that + Clause
grammar.meaningVi: Nối hệ quả hoặc nhận xét về CẢ sự việc phía trước vào cùng một câu — giúp bài Writing liền mạch, tránh chuỗi câu ngắn rời rạc.
grammar.notes: Luôn có dấu phẩy trước "which"; không dùng "that" hay "what"; động từ sau "which" chia số ít vì "which" thay cho cả một sự việc.

examples.en: Concrete, brick and asphalt absorb heat during the day and release it slowly after dark, which means that city streets often remain uncomfortably warm long after the sun has set.
examples.vi: Bê tông, gạch và nhựa đường hấp thụ nhiệt ban ngày và toả ra chậm sau khi trời tối, điều đó có nghĩa là đường phố thường vẫn nóng khó chịu rất lâu sau khi mặt trời lặn.

examples.en: Trees also absorb rainwater, which reduces flooding.
examples.vi: Cây cũng hấp thụ nước mưa, điều này giúp giảm ngập lụt.

examples.en: Many graduates move abroad, which leads to a shortage of skilled workers.
examples.vi: Nhiều sinh viên tốt nghiệp ra nước ngoài, điều này dẫn đến tình trạng thiếu lao động có tay nghề.

confusedWith: N, which + V (which = danh từ ngay trước)
N + that + V (mệnh đề xác định)

exercises.prompt: Many young people are moving to big cities, which ___ pressure on housing and transport.
answer: puts
exercises.explanation: "which" thay cho cả sự việc → động từ số ít: puts.

exercises.prompt: The factory closed in 2020, which ___ hundreds of workers without jobs.
answer: left
exercises.explanation: Sự việc trong quá khứ → left.

exercises.prompt: More students are studying online, which ___ that universities need better digital infrastructure.
answer: means
exercises.explanation: which means that… — động từ số ít.

exercises.prompt: The government has raised fuel taxes, ___ has encouraged more people to use public transport.
answer: which
exercises.explanation: Thay cho cả mệnh đề, sau dấu phẩy → which (không dùng that).

exercises.prompt: Global temperatures rose sharply last year, which ___ the frequency of extreme weather events.
answer: increased
exercises.explanation: last year → quá khứ đơn: increased.

exercises.prompt: Many species are losing their habitats, that threatens biodiversity in the region.
answer: Many species are losing their habitats, which threatens biodiversity in the region.
exercises.explanation: Sau dấu phẩy, thay cho cả mệnh đề → which, không dùng that.

exercises.prompt: Online shopping has grown rapidly, which have forced many small shops to close.
answer: Online shopping has grown rapidly, which has forced many small shops to close.
exercises.explanation: "which" = cả sự việc → động từ số ít: has forced.

exercises.prompt: The city banned cars from the centre, what improved air quality noticeably.
answer: The city banned cars from the centre, which improved air quality noticeably.
exercises.explanation: "what" không dùng làm đại từ quan hệ nối mệnh đề → which.

exercises.prompt: Tuition fees have doubled, which mean that fewer students can afford higher education.
answer: Tuition fees have doubled, which means that fewer students can afford higher education.
exercises.explanation: which means that — động từ chia số ít.

exercises.prompt: Average life expectancy has increased, which it puts pressure on healthcare systems.
answer: Average life expectancy has increased, which puts pressure on healthcare systems.
exercises.explanation: "which" đã là chủ ngữ — không thêm "it".

exercises.prompt: Air travel has become much cheaper. This has led to a sharp rise in tourism.
exercises.instruction: Nối thành một câu, dùng ", which"
exercises.starter: Air travel has become much cheaper
answer: Air travel has become much cheaper, which has led to a sharp rise in tourism.
exercises.explanation: "This" thay cho cả câu trước → ", which".

exercises.prompt: Many farmers use chemical fertilisers. This pollutes nearby rivers.
exercises.instruction: Nối thành một câu, dùng ", which"
answer: Many farmers use chemical fertilisers, which pollutes nearby rivers.
exercises.explanation: which = việc dùng phân bón → pollutes (số ít).

exercises.prompt: The museum is now free to enter. This has doubled the number of visitors.
exercises.instruction: Nối thành một câu, dùng ", which"
exercises.starter: The museum is now free to enter
answer: The museum is now free to enter, which has doubled the number of visitors.
exercises.explanation: This → , which.

exercises.prompt: Most employees now work from home twice a week. This reduces traffic at peak times.
exercises.instruction: Nối thành một câu, dùng ", which"
exercises.starter: Most employees now work from home twice a week
answer: Most employees now work from home twice a week, which reduces traffic at peak times.
exercises.explanation: which thay cho cả sự việc → reduces.

exercises.prompt: The river flooded the town last spring. This caused serious damage to local businesses.
exercises.instruction: Nối thành một câu, dùng ", which"
exercises.starter: The river flooded the town last spring
answer: The river flooded the town last spring, which caused serious damage to local businesses.
exercises.explanation: This → , which; giữ thì quá khứ.

exercises.prompt: Nhiều người dùng phương tiện công cộng, điều này giúp giảm ô nhiễm không khí.
answer: Many people use public transport, which helps to reduce air pollution.
Many people use public transport, which helps reduce air pollution.
Many people use public transportation, which helps to reduce air pollution.
Many people use public transportation, which helps reduce air pollution.
exercises.explanation: "điều này" thay cho cả vế trước → , which.

exercises.prompt: Giá nhà tăng nhanh, điều này khiến người trẻ khó mua nhà.
answer: House prices have risen rapidly, which makes it difficult for young people to buy a home.
House prices are rising rapidly, which makes it difficult for young people to buy a home.
House prices have risen quickly, which makes it difficult for young people to buy a home.
House prices have risen rapidly, which makes it hard for young people to buy a home.
exercises.explanation: , which + makes (số ít).

exercises.prompt: Chính phủ đã cấm túi nhựa, điều này làm giảm lượng rác thải ra biển.
answer: The government has banned plastic bags, which has reduced the amount of waste entering the sea.
The government has banned plastic bags, which has reduced the amount of waste in the sea.
The government banned plastic bags, which reduced the amount of waste entering the sea.
exercises.explanation: , which + has reduced.

exercises.prompt: Nhiều sinh viên làm thêm, điều này ảnh hưởng đến kết quả học tập của họ.
answer: Many students work part-time, which affects their academic performance.
Many students have part-time jobs, which affects their academic performance.
Many students work part-time, which affects their academic results.
exercises.explanation: , which + affects (số ít).

exercises.prompt: Dân số già đi nhanh chóng, điều này tạo áp lực lên hệ thống y tế.
answer: The population is ageing rapidly, which puts pressure on the healthcare system.
The population is aging rapidly, which puts pressure on the healthcare system.
The population is ageing rapidly, which puts pressure on the health system.
The population is ageing quickly, which puts pressure on the healthcare system.
exercises.explanation: , which + puts pressure on.

exercises.prompt: Unemployment fell to 4%, ___ was the lowest figure in a decade.
answer: which
exercises.explanation: Thay cho cả sự việc, sau dấu phẩy → which; that không đứng sau dấu phẩy.

exercises.prompt: Sea levels are rising, which ___ coastal cities at greater risk of flooding.
answer: puts
exercises.explanation: "which" = cả sự việc → số ít: puts.

exercises.prompt: The study ___ was published last week shows a sharp rise in childhood obesity.
answer: that
exercises.explanation: Ở đây là mệnh đề XÁC ĐỊNH cho "the study" (không có dấu phẩy) → that/which; khác với ", which" thay cho cả câu.

exercises.prompt: Many shops now refuse cash, ___ can be a problem for elderly customers.
answer: which
exercises.explanation: ", it" sẽ tạo lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy; cần which.

exercises.prompt: Car ownership has fallen, ___ suggests that public transport is improving.
answer: which
exercises.explanation: "this" sau dấu phẩy là lỗi comma splice; dùng which để nối.

grammar.name: Mệnh đề quan hệ rút gọn bị động (Reduced relative clause – past participle)
grammar.formula:
N + V_pp (+ by/with N) + V …
= N + which/that + be + V_pp …
grammar.meaningVi: Bỏ "which/that + be" để cụm danh từ mang nghĩa bị động ngắn gọn, học thuật hơn — dùng nhiều khi mô tả số liệu, sản phẩm, chính sách.
grammar.notes: Chỉ rút gọn thành V_pp khi nghĩa bị động; nghĩa chủ động dùng V_ing. Động từ chính của câu vẫn phải chia theo chủ ngữ N.

examples.en: Reflective or 'cool' roofs, painted white or covered with light-coloured membranes, send most sunlight back into the sky instead of absorbing it.
examples.vi: Mái nhà phản xạ hay "mái mát", được sơn trắng hoặc phủ màng sáng màu, đẩy phần lớn ánh nắng trở lại bầu trời thay vì hấp thụ.

examples.en: Green roofs, planted with grass and shallow-rooted plants, work in a similar way.
examples.vi: Mái xanh, được trồng cỏ và cây rễ nông, hoạt động theo cách tương tự.

examples.en: Products made from recycled plastic are becoming more popular.
examples.vi: Các sản phẩm làm từ nhựa tái chế ngày càng phổ biến.

confusedWith: N + V_ing (+ O) (rút gọn chủ động)

exercises.prompt: The data ___ in the survey suggest that most commuters would prefer to cycle.

exercises.prompt: Houses ___ before 1950 are often poorly insulated.

exercises.prompt: The report publishing by the WHO shows a rise in childhood obesity.
answer: The report published by the WHO shows a rise in childhood obesity.
exercises.explanation: Báo cáo "được công bố" (có by) → V_pp: published.

exercises.prompt: Vegetables growing without pesticides are usually more expensive.
answer: Vegetables grown without pesticides are usually more expensive.
exercises.explanation: Rau "được trồng" → grown.

exercises.prompt: Most of the plastic is produced every year ends up in landfill.
answer: Most of the plastic produced every year ends up in landfill.
exercises.explanation: Câu chỉ có một động từ chính (ends up) → rút gọn bỏ "is": produced.

exercises.prompt: The measures introduce last year have already reduced traffic congestion.
answer: The measures introduced last year have already reduced traffic congestion.
exercises.explanation: Biện pháp "được đưa ra" → introduced.

exercises.prompt: Buildings designing to save energy can cut heating costs by half.
answer: Buildings designed to save energy can cut heating costs by half.
exercises.explanation: Toà nhà "được thiết kế" → designed.

exercises.prompt: The vaccines which were developed during the pandemic saved millions of lives.
exercises.instruction: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ
answer: The vaccines developed during the pandemic saved millions of lives.
exercises.explanation: Bỏ "which were" → developed.

exercises.prompt: Food that is wasted in restaurants could feed thousands of people.
exercises.instruction: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ
answer: Food wasted in restaurants could feed thousands of people.
exercises.explanation: Bỏ "that is" → wasted.

exercises.prompt: The results which were published in 2022 surprised many scientists.
exercises.instruction: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ
answer: The results published in 2022 surprised many scientists.
exercises.explanation: Bỏ "which were" → published.

exercises.prompt: Cars that are powered by electricity produce no exhaust fumes.

answer: Cars powered by electricity produce no exhaust fumes.
exercises.explanation: Bỏ "that are" → powered.

exercises.prompt: Many of the jobs which are created by tourism are seasonal.
exercises.instruction: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ
answer: Many of the jobs created by tourism are seasonal.
exercises.explanation: Bỏ "which are" → created.

exercises.prompt: Những ngôi nhà được xây bằng gỗ thường mát hơn vào mùa hè.
answer: Houses built of wood are usually cooler in summer.
Houses built from wood are usually cooler in summer.
Houses made of wood are usually cooler in summer.
Houses built of wood are often cooler in summer.

exercises.prompt: Phần lớn rác thải được tạo ra ở các thành phố không được tái chế.

Most of the waste generated in cities is not recycled.
Most waste produced in cities is not recycled.
Most waste generated in cities is not recycled.

exercises.prompt: Các khoá học được dạy bằng tiếng Anh thu hút nhiều sinh viên quốc tế.

Courses taught in English attract a lot of international students.

answer: Information shared on social media is not always accurate.

exercises.prompt: Năng lượng được sản xuất từ gió và mặt trời ngày càng rẻ.
answer: Energy produced from wind and solar power is becoming cheaper.
Energy generated from wind and solar power is becoming cheaper.
Energy produced from wind and sunlight is becoming cheaper.
Energy produced from wind and solar power is getting cheaper.

exercises.prompt: The number of people ___ in the service sector has risen steadily.
answer: employed

answer: doing
exercises.explanation: Sinh viên TỰ làm việc (chủ động) → rút gọn bằng V_ing.

exercises.prompt: The bridge, ___ in 1890, is still used by thousands of cars every day.
answer: built

grammar.name: Cấu trúc "… và S cũng vậy" (so / neither + trợ động từ + S)
grammar.formula:
Clause (khẳng định), and so + do/does/did/be/have/modal + S

grammar.meaningVi: Nói "S cũng vậy" mà không lặp lại cả vế — đảo trợ động từ lên trước chủ ngữ, giúp câu gọn và tự nhiên hơn trong Writing/Speaking.
grammar.notes: Trợ động từ theo vế trước: be → be, have → have, modal → modal, động từ thường → do/does/did; chia theo chủ ngữ ĐỨNG SAU. Vế trước phủ định → neither/nor.

grammar.name: Cấu trúc "khiến cái gì trở nên…" (make + O + Adj)
grammar.formula:
S + make + O + Adj
S + make + it + Adj + (for O) + to_V
grammar.meaningVi: Diễn đạt nguyên nhân dẫn đến một trạng thái — gọn và mạnh hơn "cause O to become…", rất hữu ích khi viết về hệ quả trong Task 2.
grammar.notes: Sau make + O là TÍNH TỪ (không phải trạng từ). Khi tân ngữ là một hành động dài, dùng "make it + Adj + (for O) + to_V". Khác với make + O + V (bắt ai làm gì).

examples.en: Dark roofs make the problem worse, and so does the lack of vegetation.

grammar.name: Danh động từ làm chủ ngữ (Gerund as subject)
grammar.formula:
V_ing (+ O) + V_s / is / has …
Not + V_ing (+ O) + V_s …
grammar.meaningVi: Dùng một hành động làm chủ ngữ — cách mở câu rất tự nhiên và học thuật trong Writing Task 2 ("Investing in…", "Reducing…").
grammar.notes: Chủ ngữ danh động từ luôn coi là SỐ ÍT → động từ chia số ít, kể cả khi tân ngữ số nhiều ("Planting trees IS…"). Không dùng động từ nguyên mẫu làm chủ ngữ.

confusedWith: to_V + V_s (to-V làm chủ ngữ, trang trọng)
